lines.zh: 我爬过礁石，八条腿轮流落下。
lines.en: I crawl over the reef, eight legs falling in turn.

lines.zh: 蛛丝从我腹下拉出来，是湿的。
lines.en: Silk pulls from my belly, wet with seawater.
I cross the tidal flat sideways.

lines.zh: 我原本是蜘蛛，现在不完全是。
lines.en: I was a spider; now I am not quite one.

lines.zh: 我的腿太多了，可都很好用。
lines.en: Too many legs, and all of them useful.

lines.zh: 我踩过海藻，留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: I step over kelp and leave a wet trail.
I climb the rock face.

lines.zh: 我落在你上方的石头上。
lines.en: I land on the stone above you.

lines.zh: 我的关节里能听见水声。
lines.en: You can hear water in my joints.
I spin silk as I walk.
I step around a crab.
I am not fast, but I never stop.
I move along the tide line.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上像一团乱线。
lines.en: My shadow on the sand is a knot of lines.
I swim a short way through the shallows.
I crawl in your direction.

lines.zh: 我伏在礁石上，腿收起来。
lines.en: I crouch on the reef with my legs drawn in.
Water seeps from my shell seams.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛太多了，看着不舒服。
lines.en: I have too many eyes, and it is unsettling.
I wait for the tide to rise a little.
My web hangs beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像一堆海草。
lines.en: Still, I look like a heap of kelp.
I spin out a strand.

lines.zh: 我的腿尖在沙子上一敲一敲。
lines.en: My leg tips tap the sand.

lines.zh: 我听见水里有东西在动。
lines.en: I hear something moving in the water.
All eight of my eyes lie flat on the stone.
I feel which way the current runs.
I know this shore.
I shake the droplets off my legs.
I do not intend to move first.

lines.zh: 你踩的这张网，是我吐的。
lines.en: This web under your foot came from me.
All my eyes are on you.
You still smell of the old world.
I used to fear people.
Now I fear nothing.
Step back; the water will splash.
I count the pieces of meat on you.

lines.zh: 你来的方向，有海的味道。
lines.en: The way you came smells of the sea.

lines.zh: 你的脚离我的网太近了。
lines.en: Your feet are much too close to my web.
The silk has already reached your feet.
I draw in my legs and crawl back.
A piece of shell breaks off.
One leg short, and I still crawl.
Water flows from the wound.
I spit out a tangle of silk.
I roll over and back.
I hiss, and it does not sound like a spider.
I retreat half a block and stop.
My silk has caught your blood.
I am not dead yet.
No blood in this, so I don't want it.
I only eat what is still moving.
What you hold is not an insect.

lines.zh: 海里的东西更合我胃口。
lines.en: What lives in the sea suits me better.
I sniff it and back away.
Put that away.
My jaws are wrong for that.
Do not reach toward me.
It is more interesting than you.
I bind it with silk.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，被粘住了。
lines.en: You hit a leg and stick.
My shell is wet and slippery.
All eight of my legs claw at the air.
All eight legs brace.
You snap one of my threads.
I crawl over your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的湿壳贴上来，滑开了。
lines.en: My wet shell presses close, then slides off.
I press against you and do not yield.
Two shell flakes drop from my legs.
Do not push; the silk will break.
There are others in the web.
We all changed here.
The silk tangles and cannot be separated.

lines.zh: 我们的丝缠成同一张网。
lines.en: Our silk tangles into one shared web.
There will be more eggs under the water.
I follow the silk to find them.

lines.zh: 同类的腿声我能听出来。
lines.en: I can hear a kin's legs.
Together we widen the web.
The tide will carry all of this away.
Then we scatter again.
I hoist it with silk.
Two legs are enough to hold it.
This drop is soaked.
It sticks to my thread.
I drag it behind the reef.
I take it in my jaws.
What falls into the water is mine.
I wrap it in a cocoon.
There is not much meat on it.

lines.zh: 扯下的海藻黏在颚上，我留着。
lines.en: The kelp I tore off sticks to my jaws; I'll keep it.
My web moved.
You are an insect, only larger.

lines.zh: 八只眼在网中央，都对着你。
lines.en: Eight eyes in the web's center, all on you.
I crouch and spread my legs.
The silk below is already laid.

lines.zh: 我的丝已经横在你脚前。
lines.en: My silk already lies across your feet.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，这片岸都是网。
lines.en: You cannot escape; this shore is all web.
I begin to close in.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的鞋底有血腥味。
lines.en: I smell blood on the soles of your boots.
I choose you.

lines.zh: 丝从我腹下一根根出来。
lines.en: Threads come from my belly one by one.
You step back, right into the web.
I wait on the stone for you to look up.
The tide rises and your path shrinks.
I spin a thicker strand.
You are walking toward me.

lines.zh: 我不急，网会替你留住你。
lines.en: No hurry; the web will hold you.

lines.zh: 我沿着岩壁向你垂下去。
lines.en: I lower myself toward you along the cliff.
Your foot is caught.

lines.zh: 这一口我已经等了很久。
lines.en: I have waited long for this bite.
My foreleg stabs your shoulder.
I bite down, and it is wet.
I bind you up.

lines.zh: 腿上带毒，你该感觉到了。
lines.en: There is venom on my legs; you should feel it.
I drop from the ridge onto your back.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了一条腿。
lines.en: That one used a single leg.
The silk drags you down.
My jaws are not sharp, but they are heavy.
My jaws clamp onto your forearm.

lines.zh: 你挣断了一根丝，还有更多。
lines.en: You break one thread; there are more.

lines.zh: 一只蜘蛛沉进水里，我浮上来。
lines.en: A spider sinks into the water, and I surface.

lines.zh: 海嗣的气味进了它的身体。
lines.en: The seaborn scent entered its body.

lines.zh: 我从湿透的网里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a soaked web.
This body is larger than the old one.
My legs grew two more.
The tide pushes me onto the reef.
I take shape in a crack between stones.
Something flashes under the water.

lines.zh: 我从一层湿网里挣出来。
lines.en: I tear my way out of a soaked web.
This web is newly spun.

lines.zh: 火烤干我的壳，我疼得乱爬。
lines.en: Fire dries my shell and I scramble in pain.

lines.zh: 我从岩上掉下，腿蜷成一团。
lines.en: I fall from the rock and my legs curl up.

lines.zh: 水太多也会淹，我拼命划。
lines.en: Too much water drowns even me; I kick hard.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，丝全断了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and every thread snaps.
An arrow passes through my abdomen.

lines.zh: 咒光在我身上烧出焦斑。
lines.en: Spell-light burns a scorch mark into me.
Too long hungry and my silk grows thin.

lines.zh: 雷落到我身上，腿一阵抽搐。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my legs spasm.

lines.zh: 虚空里连网都织不出来。
lines.en: I cannot even spin a web in the void.
